title: Nature Trail Signs

readiness.reading: building three-letter words from their sounds; spelling without the letters shown (older)

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Hello! I'm making a nature trail through the grove, so everyone can find the little wonders here.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Each wonder needs a sign. Could you make the words? Tap a picture to hear its name.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Listen to the name. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the name. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Let's put them up along the trail. Now everyone can find the wonders!

journal_line: I made signs for the nature trail in the grove with Mr. Tobias.
unavailable_text: The trail signs are up. Can you find them all?
